description: Delete a calendar event, or cancel dates of a recurring one; this cannot be undone. A one-off or recurring event's UUID deletes it and every date: it disappears at once and is removed in the background. A dated ID (<uuid>_<slot>) cancels that date, or with mode future that date and every later one. Attendees are emailed a cancellation only with sendInvites, and only for events this inbox organizes. Calendar works for every organization in US production; EU production returns 403 "Calendar isn't available in this region yet".

eventId.description: Event ID: a one-off or recurring event's UUID, or a dated ID (<uuid>_<slot>) for one date of a recurring event; from get_agenda, create_event, or a message's calendarEventId

ifMatch.description: Optional: the etag from your latest read or write of it. The change is then refused with 412 if it changed since; without it the change applies to it as it is now

inboxId.description: Inbox ID: the inbox's email address, from list_inboxes

mode.description: For a dated ID only: single (the default) changes just that date, future that date and every later one

sendInvites.description: Email every attendee a cancellation (one send per attendee against send limits). Only for events this inbox organizes
